note: Family-run campground among the river valley's mature trees in North Drumheller, across the bridge from the World's Largest Dinosaur and a short walk to downtown; tent sites, 10 cabins, a bubble tent and on-site rental trailers too. The front gate is closed (not locked) from 11 pm to 7 am. --Claude
summary: Campspot quotes (2026-27) confirm C$60 base (30A power/water) to C$65 (full service) + GST + C$3 booking fee; sites 140 -> 98 RV sites (max 45 ft, pull-throughs); season 05-01/09-30 -> 04-30/09-19 from the 2027 calendar; hookups/facilities/long-weekend minimum confirmed manual.
flags: PRICE GATE (private): base C$60 + GST (30-amp power/water, Campspot quote for 2027-06-08 and 2026-09-08; C$63 with the C$3 booking fee) - under C$69, passes. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: Calgary 105 km). Rate dated by the engine quote, not only the undated 'From $60' page.
Google Maps 4.1 stars from 625 reviews, +1 403-823-6655 (matches stored), website camprivergrove.com (200, this campground).

LONG-STAY: no weekly/monthly/seasonal offer on the operator site or Campspot; every RV type (98 sites) sells single nights and all 49 power/water sites were open for a June 2027 weeknight - passes all five tests.
SITES: stored 140 (note prose) -> 98 bookable RV sites on Campspot (operator says 'Over 100 RV sites'); 44 tent sites are separate. Mixed RV/tent sites are 20-28 ft; the other types run to 40-45 ft.
SEASON: 2027 Campspot calendar opens April 30 and the last bookable night is September 18 - narrower at the end than the stored 05-01..09-30.
Waterfront: stored not waterfront kept. The sites are under cottonwoods; a flood berm with a trail runs between the campground and the Red Deer River, the nearest sites ~100 m from the water.
